en: The Triplet on the Cause of Seeing (Dassanahetuttika)
Dependent on a state whose root is to be abandoned by seeing, there arises a state whose root is to be abandoned by seeing, by way of the root condition. (Abbreviated.

In the root [condition], twenty-six; in the object [condition], twenty-one; in the predominance [condition], eighteen … pe … in the resultant [condition], three … pe … in the non-disappearance [condition], twenty-six.
